findings.title: Net cash still omits $34.1B marketable debt securities (and $42.8B marketable equity securities); published target price unchanged by the fix
findings.detail: Round 2 numerical/recompute/valuation.json (identical to computed/) still has net_cash = cash 22.443B + short_term_investments 0 - debt 33.366B = -10.923B. The 2026-07-26 balance sheet reports marketable debt securities of 34,143m (Q-11; Treasury 33,003m Q-15 plus agency 1,140m Q-16; the company reports cash, cash equivalents and marketable debt securities of 56,586m, Q-14) and marketable equity securities of 42,783m (Q-12). Debt is complete. The generator has done what it can: gen-mapping re-verified that no snapshot concept or sum of concepts carries these balances; valuation_inputs.json rationales.net_cash gives a reasoned treatment (debt securities at full value; equity securities at a 30% haircut, justified by $36.9B of lock-ups (Q-17), concentration and tax on unrealised gains; non-marketable securities excluded) and a preferred net cash of +53.168B; and the note quotes the amounts and says the rating does not change. I reproduced the offline figures with src/aicfinal/valuation.py dcf() and the blending formula at WACC 10.7%: code as published gives blended $181.53, TP $182, upside -13.2%; debt securities only gives $182.94, TP $183, -12.7%; debt plus haircut equity gives $184.17, TP $184, -12.2%; both at full value gives $184.70, TP $185, -11.8%. All are Underperform. Neither alternative in the required evidence has been met, though. valuation.json net_cash does not include the debt securities, so the published TP of $182 is still below the candidate's own preferred $184. No controller-recorded decision accepting the understatement exists: state.json, decision_note.md and the round-1 decision.json contain none. The note gives the effect only qualitatively ('raises the target only slightly'; 'margin to the Neutral band edge narrows to about two percentage points at most'), with no target-price figures. This is a code/controller issue, not a generator error (see the gen-lead manifest integration.unresolved). It stays major until either a code mechanism feeds filing-text balance-sheet items into net_cash or the controller records acceptance.
evidence: src/aicfinal/valuation.py value(): net_cash = cash + sti - debt
findings.required_evidence: valuation.json net_cash includes the $34.143B marketable debt securities (and either includes the $42.783B marketable equity securities with a stated haircut or gives a documented reason for leaving them out), with target price and upside recomputed; or a controller-recorded decision that accepts the understatement, with the note quantifying the target-price effect (about $1-3 per share; upside -12.7% to -11.8%).

resolved.evidence: valuation_inputs.json now uses WACC 0.107, the unrounded CAPM figure. The rationale explains that the round-1 round-down had no basis and shows the arithmetic: 0.9934 x 10.75% + 0.0066 x 3.7% = 10.70%; equity of 24,100M x $209.66 = about $5.05T; debt weight about 0.66%. I checked all of these. I reproduced the stated Neutral thresholds with code's dcf() and blend: on code's net cash, blended $188.45 at 10.19% against the 188.5 needed for TP $189, so the threshold is about 10.18-10.19%; about 10.28-10.29% with debt securities; 10.37% with debt plus haircut equity; 10.41% with both at full value. The note's Model and valuation (discount rate) paragraph and its Risks section state that a WACC roughly a third to a half of a percentage point lower would move the rating to Neutral. That matches the 33-51bp gaps. Moving to 10.7% takes the rating further from Neutral, but it is the computed figure the round-1 finding pointed to, not a rating-driven choice. The terminal share is 71.1%, under 80%.

The note's Model and valuation section states that peer TTM windows end in May-June 2026 (AVGO and MRVL in May, AMD in June) against July 2026 for NVDA, which matches the peers.json ttm_end dates 2026-05-03, 2026-05-02 and 2026-06-27. rationales.peers explains that the 'CY2025Q4' calendar label comes from code (xbrl.calendar_label, TTM-window midpoint) and records that it was flagged to the controller; the gen-lead manifest lists it under integration.unresolved. That is the 'flagged to the controller' branch of the required evidence. Correcting the label itself is a code matter.
